# P2: billing refund requests that are not questions
if contains "refund" and not contains "question" and queue == billing -> P2
# P2: billing overcharges (double charges, double billing) that are not questions
if contains "double charged" and not contains "question" and queue == billing -> P2
if contains "double billed" and not contains "question" and queue == billing -> P2
if contains "overcharged" and not contains "question" and queue == billing -> P2
# P2: technical bugs that send duplicate or repeated messages/actions to customers
if contains "twice" and queue == technical -> P2
if contains "duplicate" and queue == technical -> P2
# P2: shipments that were lost, missing, damaged, or never delivered
if contains "lost" and queue == shipping -> P2
if contains "never arrived" and queue == shipping -> P2
if contains "missing" and queue == shipping -> P2
if contains "damaged" and queue == shipping -> P2
# Default
default -> P3
